featured_reviews.name: Cari D Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (If zero stars were possible, that’s what I’d give.)

This has been one of the worst garage experiences I’ve had.

I trusted this garage only because they are a signature partner of GoMechanic, a company I’ve worked with since its early days and serviced multiple cars through successfully. Based on that trust, I handed over my vintage Maruti Zen, a car I’ve invested heavily in over the years.

I was quoted for the work, agreed to the pricing, and was told it would take time—which I accepted. What followed was 6–8 months of delays, excuses, and eventually, complete lack of accountability.

Major issues:

My original seats were lost, and replacements were arranged as if they were doing me a favor
Multiple spares were damaged or broken
Expensive electrical wiring was returned in a completely jumbled state
My Pioneer head unit (₹13–15k) was left dangling and unsecured
RPM meter, clock, wipers, and audio system were fully functional when handed over, but returned non-functional with the excuse that “things stop working if a car is kept long”
While the car was with them, it was repeatedly parked improperly, resulting in ~₹20,000 in RTO fines, which I am now forced to pay
When I raised these issues, the response was arrogant. I was told to take the car elsewhere, stand in the sun, and get it fixed myself. No responsibility, no ownership.
Yes, the car looks okay cosmetically—but functionally it is not restored, even after 8 months.
I would not recommend this garage at all for direct work.
If you’re using GoMechanic, choose a different garage.
If you’re considering working with them directly—don’t.
I’m a garage owner myself, and I say this with experience: this was a complete failure of professionalism.
for parts working when they took the car and not working now they asked for a video and proof that it was working then only they will repair
AVOID this place

UPDATE:

I had to spend 30K to rectify the job, including the ob of under body which was very poorly done and not coated. Please ask and I'll share a video. including 28K in traffic fines. He could have, instead of ruining my car on the road, paid for MGCM parking it would have been cheaper. I wud have volunteered to do so if asked. anything beats ruining my car

AVOID
